_README: COMMITTED per-lane mask configuration. This file is the answer to
'which mask parameters produced this vector' — a file you read, not
archaeology across .env, systemd drop-ins, and code defaults.
Why it exists: analysis/gpu_run7/c1_determinism/REPORT.md (pipeline repo).
The knobs used to live in the pipeline repo's .env; .env is gitignored, so
'git archive HEAD' correctly does not ship it, and a rented GPU pod ran L1
with different parameters and produced different vectors from identical
bytes — silently (masked:true, no fallback, no no-op). Committed config
travels with git archive, so a pod gets these BY CONSTRUCTION rather than
by discipline.
Governing: specs/mask_config_provenance_ruling.md (pipeline repo),
architect 2026-08-15, plus its five-knob brain amendment. THE VALUES BELOW
ARE THE RULING, TRANSCRIBED. Do not re-derive them and do not tune them
here: a value change is a mask-lane generation bump and needs its own
ruling, its own bars, and a mask_lane_version bump.
JSON and not YAML on purpose: neither trivalaya-vision venv has PyYAML, and
the repo that owns the knobs must be able to read its own config.
gpu_embed is value-identical to ingest by ruling 1. It is written as its
own entry anyway, so the corpus arm is a line someone can read rather than
an equivalence they must infer. (Their digests are equal by construction —
the digest covers values only, not the lane name — which is what makes
'the corpus embedded under the ingest arm' checkable rather than asserted.)
tools exists so ad-hoc and analysis scripts have a lane to NAME instead of
a reason to bypass.
_mask_lane_version: Code version of the mask lane — bumped when the mask CODE changes shape,
independently of these values. Carried alongside the resolved values in
the embedding-store stamp; it is not a substitute for them (ruling 2
rider 1: a version/hash says two generations differ, not how).

_keys.close_kernel_frac: null => today's fixed 7x7 CLOSE kernel. 'auto' => membership-gated per-house table (layer1_geometry._close_kernel_size). A numeric string forces that fraction for every house (the SS4.2 sweep knob).
_keys.rim_neighbor_guard: true => _revert_neighbor_overlapping_recoveries() runs and reverts recovered rims that overlap a neighbour.
_keys.bg_corner_local_trust: true => math_utils M1 per-corner local consistency in the background estimator. Serving only (M1 leg 1, owner-signed 2026-07-28). Leg 2 (ingest) is PARKED by ruling 1, not waived.
_keys.rim_recovery_max_per_image: null => unlimited (today's behaviour): every need_recovery contour attempts rim recovery. An integer caps how many may, largest-area first.
_keys.disable_two_coin_resolver: true => the two-coin resolver is not consulted even when it imported cleanly. Kill-switch.

ingest._who: trivalaya_pipeline vision_adapter — trivalaya-runner.service and the nightly vision backlog cron. The arm the existing corpus was built under.

gpu_embed._who: Run 7 corpus embed on rented GPU hardware. Value-identical to ingest by ruling 1 — the corpus embeds under the INGEST arm, explicitly stamped.

tools._who: ad-hoc analysis, measurement scripts, A/B harnesses. Value-identical to ingest: that is what an analysis script sourcing .env has always got.
